reason: Most days I just buy a 50-baht plate, and when I do cook, my mum sends me the recipe on LINE or I watch a free YouTube video. I might download it and try the free basil pork, but I don't see why I'd pay for recipes I already get for free.
objection: Tom yum, pad see ew and massaman are all free on YouTube, and my mum sends me recipes anyway. I'm not sure an app chef shows me much more than a good video does, and with how little I cook I'd only make two or three of the 12 dishes.
would_change_my_mind: If I cooked the free green curry and it actually came out right where my YouTube attempts didn't, I'd pay the 99 baht. That's only two plates of food.
